dz: 拜占庭皇帝约翰五世·帕拉约洛戈斯和海伦娜·康塔库泽内的婚姻.
de: Marriage of Byzantine Emperor John V Palaiologos and Helena Kantakouzene.

t: 一群克特哈斯人,在图卢兹伯爵雷蒙德七世可能的默许下,谋杀了审讯官威廉·阿尔诺和他的11名同伴.
te: A group of Cathars, with the probable connivance of Count Raymond VII of Toulouse, murder the inquisitor William Arnaud…
dz: 阿维尼翁内特大屠杀:一群克特哈斯人,在图卢兹伯爵雷蒙德七世可能的默许下,谋杀了审讯官威廉·阿尔诺和他的11名同伴.
de: Avignonet massacre: A group of Cathars, with the probable connivance of Count Raymond VII of Toulouse, murder the inquisitor William Arnaud and eleven of his companions.

te: English king Æthelstan begins his invasion of Scotland.
dz: 英国国王埃塞尔斯坦开始入侵苏格兰。
de: English king Æthelstan begins his invasion of Scotland.

t: 中国高祖皇帝之子李世民在呼拉鄂口(河南)附近击败了杜建德在数量上优势的势力. 这一胜利决定了后…
te: Li Shimin, the son of the Chinese emperor Gaozu, defeats the numerically superior forces of Dou Jiande near the Hulao P…
dz: 呼拉鄂战役:中国高祖皇帝之子李世民在呼拉鄂口(河南)附近击败了杜建德在数量上优势的势力. 这一胜利决定了后苏王朝倒台后有利于唐朝的内战结果.
de: Battle of Hulao: Li Shimin, the son of the Chinese emperor Gaozu, defeats the numerically superior forces of Dou Jiande near the Hulao Pass (Henan). This victory decides the outcome of the civil war that followed the Sui dynasty's collapse in favour of the Tang dynasty.

t: 正如希腊哲学家和科学家Thales所预测的那样,日食时有发生,而Alyattes则在埃克利佩斯…
te: A solar eclipse occurs, as predicted by the Greek philosopher and scientist Thales, while Alyattes is battling Cyaxares…
dz: 正如希腊哲学家和科学家Thales所预测的那样,日食时有发生,而Alyattes则在埃克利佩斯之战中与Cyaxares作对,导致停战. 这是可以计算出其他日期的主要日期之一。 这也是最早知道确切日期的事件.
de: A solar eclipse occurs, as predicted by the Greek philosopher and scientist Thales, while Alyattes is battling Cyaxares in the Battle of the Eclipse, leading to a truce. This is one of the cardinal dates from which other dates can be calculated. It is also the earliest event of which the precise date is known.
